description: Produce a standard-library Python module that infers a JSON Schema from sample records, plus pytest tests. Choose this when you need a draft 2020-12 JSON Schema inferred from sample objects, with keys present in every record marked required. Do not choose this for a hand-tuned schema or for constraints the samples do not express (formats, ranges, enums). Example requests: Write a Python module that infers a JSON Schema from sample records, with tests. | I need a JSON Schema generated from example objects, marking common keys as required. | Generate a schema-inference module and prove it with pytest.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

function_name.description: Name of the function the module must define.

module_name.description: Lowercase module name, used for the file name.

template.description: Which registered behaviour to produce. The behaviour is fixed by the template and verified by the template's own tests.

inputs.title: JSON Schema inference module with pytest tests

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
